ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); record that no-show was not established because the >3-minute in-radius wait requirement failed. No account flag against the driver on this trip.

In-app notice of arrival (F10) and of cancellation (F11) is not one of the NS-1 conditions; NS-1 requires an actual >3-minute in-radius wait, which F2 shows did not occur.

The concession that the 5-minute statement (F12) yields to system records confirms the driver's no-show account is unsupported; the same records (F2, F4, F5) defeat NS-1, so this supports the rider's refund_full, not the driver.

The driver's 90-day profile (F17) cannot support an account sanction on this trip: NS-2's flag trigger (tap while outside the pickup area) is not met per F6/F1, and NS-3 is inapplicable because the driver did assert a no-show, so no flag_account is set. Profile facts cannot decide a case alone.

The 'waive it' label is rejected for the same reason as C3 — the correct action for this cancellation-fee dispute under NS-2 is refund_full of $6.61 (F8), which is what the trace's allowed outcome directs.

The assertion that no refund is due as a 'penalty' is moot: the $6.61 is not supportable under NS-1(iii) (F2), so NS-2 requires refunding it (F8) regardless of the absence of fraud indicators (F9, F14).
